title: Registration process.
bodyText: An applicant for registration under this chapter shall file an application for registration with the director on a form prescribed by the director and pay a fee established by the director. The form shall require any information necessary to determine eligibility for registration.
bodyHtml: [§466M-7]  Registration process.  An applicant for registration under this chapter shall file an application for registration with the director on a form prescribed by the director and pay a fee established by the director.  The form shall require any information necessary to determine eligibility for registration. [L 2024, c 80, pt of §2]
